title: Quote Tolerance Percentage by Finch Circle Tier and Card Relationship — Marlowe & Finch Alterations
content:
The quote tolerance percentage on a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket is set by two relationships: membership at Finch Circle Platinum or above in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program (a tier whose qualifying spend threshold is 2500.00 USD or more, membership active), and an active account with Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards.

| Active member at Finch Circle Platinum or above | Holds an active Marlowe & Finch card account | Quote tolerance percentage |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 5 percent |
| yes | no | 8 percent |
| no | yes | 8 percent |
| no | no | the class's quote-overrun tolerance percentage |

**Records read.** The tier and status of the customer's Finch Circle membership; the status of each of the customer's Marlowe & Finch card accounts (any card in the program counts, provided the account is active).

## Points of judgement

- 5 percent needs both relationships at once; either one alone gives 8 percent.
- A Finch Circle Gold member (tier threshold below 2500.00 USD) is not a member at Platinum or above: with an active card account, 8 percent; without one, the class's own percentage.
- A card account that is closed does not count as an active account.

## Hypothetical illustration

An active Finch Circle Diamond member holding an active Marlowe & Finch Store Card: 5 percent. The same member after closing the card, with no other active account: 8 percent.
